comments.author: @GlobeLifeDocs
comments.text: This video is a powerful and eye-opening documentary! It’s heartbreaking to see how the Marshall Islands suffer from the dual heavy impact of history—enduring 67 nuclear tests—and the present threat of rising sea levels. Yet, the resilience of the Marshallese people is truly inspiring. From their incredible traditional wave-navigation skills to their bold determination to raise their land rather than abandon it, their strength and love for their homeland deeply touched me.
